newsitem.title: USA: Cerprobe sees 97 improvements in all units.
newsitem.headline: Cerprobe sees 97 improvements in all units.

text.p: Cerprobe Corp said Tuesday it is optimistic for the remainer of 1997 because of the ongoing recovery in the worldwide chip market, and it expects to see further improvements in all business lines.

The company said its two recent acquisitions, CompuRoute and Silicon Valley Test & Repair, had combined sales during the quarter of about $4.6 million, a 16 percent increase over the first quarter of 1997.
It said Silicon Valley's sales and profitability, however, were below target.

With Silicon Valley's move from California to Arizona, the company expects an acceleration in new product development and related sales, as well as further improvements in its manufacturing operations.
In addition, sales of probe cards and ATE interfaces, which accounted for about 75 percent of total sales during the second quarter, were up 46 percent over the comparable quarter in 1996.
The company reported income per share of $0.24 per share, on 13 percent more shares outstanding, compared with $0.15 per share for the same period a year ago.
